div.head: Wi 18[a]
div.ab: Preost hine clænsie sylfæs soþe in his halgum hrægle ætforan wiofode ðus cweþende: ‘Ueritatem dico in Christo, non mentior’.
Preost hine clænsie sylfæs soþe in his halgum hrægle ætforan wiofode, ðus cweþende: Veritatem dico in xro non mentior.
A priest should clear himself with his own truth in his holy vestments before the altar, thus saying: Ueritatem dico in Christo, non mentior.
A priest shall clear himself by his own asseveration, [standing] in his holy garments before the altar and declaring as follows “Veritatem dico in Christo, non mentior.”
A priest is to purge himself with his own asseveration in his holy vestments before the altar, saying thus: “I speak the truth in Christ, I do not lie.” Similarly a deacon is to purge himself.
Ein Priester reinige sich durch Betheuerung [nur] von [ihm] selbst in seinem heiligen [Amts]gewande vor dem Altar so sprechend: ‘Veritatem dico in Christo, non mentior’.
A priest is to clear himself by a declaration [only] of [him]self in his holy [vestment of] office before the altar, speaking thus: ‘Veritatem dico in Christo, non mentior’.
div.note: Whitelock translates Wi 18 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 18[a], 18[b]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.
